plugins.name: token-watch
plugins.description: Plan usage, the context window and the prompt cache countdown as a banner above the Claude Code prompt, with burn rates, alerts and an opt-in keep-warm. TW Settings picks what it shows; TW Monitor lists every session's context and cache. /token-watch hides the banner, or prints it as text where it can't be drawn.
